ic_name: HDMI / DVI TMDS (TI TFP410 PanelBus Digital Transmitter — subset)
register_map_summary: The TFP410 datasheet defines a small register file accessible via I2C (ISEL=1). Page mode is not supported; only byte read/write cycles. Base 7-bit I2C address = 0b0111_A3A2A1 (write 0x70..0x7E, read 0x71..0x7F per A[3:1] pin straps).

registers.name: VEN_ID
registers.purpose: Texas Instruments vendor ID; hardwired to 0x014C.

fields.name: VEN_ID
fields.description: 16-bit vendor ID (hardwired 0x014C).

registers.name: DEV_ID
registers.purpose: Device ID for TFP410; hardwired to 0x0410.

fields.name: DEV_ID
fields.description: 16-bit device ID (hardwired 0x0410).

fields.name: REV_ID
fields.description: Revision ID.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved.

registers.name: CTL_1_MODE
registers.purpose: Primary control mode register: TMDS disable, VSYNC/HSYNC enable, DSEL/BSEL/EDGE input config, and power-down (PD).

fields.name: RSVD
fields.description: Reserved.

fields.name: TDIS
fields.description: T.M.D.S. disable mode. 0=TMDS enable determined by PD; 1=TMDS circuitry disabled.

fields.name: VEN
fields.description: VSYNC enable. 0=VSYNC transmitted as fixed LOW; 1=VSYNC transmitted in original state.

fields.name: HEN
fields.description: HSYNC enable. 0=HSYNC transmitted as fixed LOW; 1=HSYNC transmitted in original state.

fields.name: DSEL
fields.description: Combined with BSEL+VREF to select single-ended vs differential clock mode.

fields.name: BSEL
fields.description: Input bus-width select. 0=12-bit dual-edge; 1=24-bit single-edge.

fields.name: EDGE
fields.description: Edge select. 0=latch on IDCK+ falling edge; 1=latch on IDCK+ rising edge.

fields.name: PD
fields.description: Power-down mode. 0=power down (default after RESET); 1=normal operation.

registers.name: CTL_2_MODE
registers.purpose: Monitor sense / interrupt control: VREF state, MSEN output source, interrupt source, RSEN status, HTPLG status, MDI interrupt flag.

fields.name: VLOW
fields.description: Read-only. 0=VREF selects high-swing; 1=VREF selects low-swing inputs.

fields.name: MSEL
fields.description: MSEN pin output source: 000=disabled (HIGH); 001=output MDI; 010=output RSEN; 011=output HTPLG.

fields.name: TSEL
fields.description: Interrupt source select. 0=MDI generated from RSEN; 1=MDI generated from HTPLG.

fields.name: RSEN
fields.description: Receiver sense. 0=no powered receiver; 1=powered receiver detected on TMDS output (DC-coupled only).

fields.name: HTPLG
fields.description: Hot-Plug Detect input status. 0=low on EDGE/HTPLG pin; 1=high on EDGE/HTPLG pin.

fields.name: MDI
fields.description: Monitor-detect interrupt. 0=logic-level change detected (write 1 to clear); 1=logic level remains the same.

registers.name: CTL_3_MODE
registers.purpose: De-skew trim + CTL[2:1] output during blanking.

fields.name: DK
fields.description: De-skew setting. Each step = t_STEP (~350 ps). 000=Step 1 (min setup / max hold); 100=Step 5 (default); 111=Step 8 (max setup / min hold).

fields.name: DKEN
fields.description: Data de-skew enable. 0=de-skew disabled (default); 1=de-skew enabled, trim per DK[3:1].

fields.name: RSVD
fields.description: Reserved.

fields.name: CTL
fields.description: CTL[2:1] values transmitted on TX2 / TX1 during DE=low blanking.

fields.name: RSVD
fields.description: Reserved.

registers.name: CFG
registers.purpose: Read-only mirror of DATA[23:16] input state (user-strap configuration bits when those pins are unused as data inputs).

fields.name: CFG
fields.description: State of DATA[23:16] pins.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved.

registers.name: DE_DLY
registers.purpose: Number of pixels after HSYNC goes active that DE is generated (when DE_GEN=1). Must satisfy DE_DLY ≤ 2047 − DE_CNT.

fields.name: DE_DLY[7:0]
fields.description: Lower 8 bits of DE delay count (top bit in DE_CTL[0]).

registers.name: DE_CTL
registers.purpose: DE generator control: enable + VSYNC/HSYNC polarities + top bit of DE_DLY.

fields.name: RSVD
fields.description: Reserved.

fields.name: DE_GEN
fields.description: DE generator enable. 0=DE pin used directly; 1=DE generator active, DE pin ignored.

fields.name: VS_POL
fields.description: VSYNC polarity. 0=active low; 1=active high (line counts reset on VSYNC active edge).

fields.name: HS_POL
fields.description: HSYNC polarity. 0=active low; 1=active high (pixel counts reset on HSYNC active edge).

fields.name: RSVD
fields.description: Reserved.

fields.name: DE_DLY[8]
fields.description: Top bit of DE_DLY counter (DE_DLY total width 9 bits).

registers.name: DE_TOP
registers.purpose: Number of pixels after VSYNC goes active that DE is generated (DE_GEN=1).

fields.name: DE_TOP
fields.description: Line offset after VSYNC for DE active region.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved.

registers.name: DE_CNT
registers.purpose: Width of active display in pixels (DE_GEN=1). Must satisfy DE_CNT ≤ 2047 − DE_DLY.

fields.name: DE_CNT[10:0]
fields.description: Active-pixel count per line.

registers.name: DE_LIN
registers.purpose: Height of active display in lines (DE_GEN=1).

fields.name: DE_LIN[10:0]
fields.description: Active-line count per frame.

registers.name: H_RES
registers.purpose: Read-only horizontal resolution counter: total pixels between consecutive HSYNC pulses.

fields.name: H_RES[10:0]
fields.description: Pixels-per-line counter.

registers.name: V_RES
registers.purpose: Read-only vertical resolution counter: total lines between consecutive VSYNC pulses.

fields.name: V_RES[10:0]
fields.description: Lines-per-frame counter.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved.

notes: All registers are 8-bit-wide on the I2C wire; 16-bit and 11-bit fields span 2 consecutive sub-addresses with auto-increment. After ISEL pulse-low reset, all registers return to defaults — notably PD=0 (powered down) so the host MUST set CTL_1_MODE.PD=1 over I2C before TMDS output is enabled.
